title: Vikram and Betal: The Lost Book
moral: Admitting mistakes is a sign of honesty.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a lost book.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a student who lost his book.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: Another student found the book but did not return it.

scenes.summary: The teacher asks about the book.
scenes.text: The teacher asked if anyone had found the book.
scenes.image_prompt: teacher asking students in classroom cartoon

scenes.text: The student felt guilty and returned it.
scenes.image_prompt: student returning book with regret cartoon

scenes.text: The teacher appreciated honesty. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A student corrected his mistake by returning a lost book. Vikram said true honesty is accepting and fixing mistakes.
